description: This is a Perl script responsible for downloading files from various mirrors, handling hash verification, and supporting multiple download tools such as curl, wget, and aria2c. It contains logic to select mirrors, validate downloads, and manage environment configurations related to OpenWrt infrastructure.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from a file and environment configurations, returns a list of mirror URLs.

methods.name: projectsmirrors
methods.description: Loads project-specific mirrors from a JSON configuration file based on the project name.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a given program is available in the system's PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hashing command (md5 or sha256) based on the length of the provided hash.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a specific download tool (like curl or wget) is available and reports its version.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects the best available download tool based on environment variables and availability.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the appropriate command line for downloading files based on the chosen tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the download operation with mirror fallback and hash verification.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary files used during download or hash verification.
